test_title: PYST 14: SSC MTS 2024 - English Language and Comprehension (Held On: 14 Oct, 2024 - Shift 3)
subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the underlined word.

The team worked together to __execute__ the challenging task.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 2**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The word **"execute"** means to carry out or put into effect a plan, order, or course of action. (क्रियान्वित करना)
 
 
• **Example:** The company hired a new manager to execute their business strategy.
 
 
 
• **"Accomplish"** means to achieve or complete successfully. (पूरा करना)
 
 
• **Example:** She was able to accomplish all her goals for the year.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the synonym of **'execute'** is 'accomplish'<
